title: Ether drift detected on Mount Wilson

tellings.quote: He didn't detect it directly, but he detected um Earth's motion through the by an experiment on Mount Wilson, I believe it was.

plain: An experiment on Mount Wilson in California is said to have picked up the Earth's motion through the ether, the invisible medium that older physics held fills all of space. The scientist Steve Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants in people, tells it from memory and gives the credit to a scientist he calls Milikin, saying the ether itself was not found directly, only the Earth's movement through it, and adding "I believe it was" about the place. If true, it would revive an idea that mainstream physics set aside.
